message: Have you ever found yourself in the middle of a blackout, surrounded by the quiet hum of a still house? I’ve learned to turn those moments into cozy evenings with candles, board games, and a little bit of imagination. This resource from Ready.gov has some great tips for navigating power outages, ensuring you’re well-prepared while keeping things light and enjoyable. What’s your favorite way to make the most of an unexpected at-home adventure?
